Parts.Description: Black void stone with flagstones along the path and a violet rune ring under the Void Shiba.
Parts.Name: Dark Platform

Parts.Description: Two obsidian pylons with cyan orbs guard the entrance, a floating arch of shards between them.
Parts.Name: Obsidian Gate

Parts.Description: A black board with violet trim that reads THE VOID, with a cyan orb on each end.
Parts.Name: Void Sign

Parts.Description: Six leaning stones around a violet rune disc, a cyan orb hovering in the middle.
Parts.Name: Rune Stones

Parts.Description: Three stone braziers burning with tall purple flames.
Parts.Name: Purple Braziers

Parts.Description: A field of tall violet, magenta and cyan crystals growing from a black rock bed.
Parts.Name: Void Crystals

Parts.Description: A field of black glass spikes of all heights.
Parts.Name: Obsidian Spikes

Parts.Description: A branching crack in the floor shining purple, pebbles drifting up out of it.
Parts.Name: Glowing Rift

Parts.Description: Four dark lamp posts with floating cyan orbs.
Parts.Name: Void Lanterns

Parts.Description: Three bare black trees carrying clouds of purple leaves.
Parts.Name: Dead Trees

Parts.Description: A stepped black altar with cyan pillars and a purple orb floating over it.
Parts.Name: Void Altar

Parts.Description: Three giant mushrooms with pale stems and bright purple caps.
Parts.Name: Glow Mushrooms

Parts.Description: Three hooded knights of black stone with glowing cyan swords, standing in a half circle.
Parts.Name: Void Knights

Parts.Description: A square pool of glowing purple liquid inside a black rim, cyan lilies on top.
Parts.Name: Void Pool

Parts.Description: Broken stone columns whose capitals have drifted up and hang above them.
Parts.Name: Floating Ruins

Parts.Description: Three black tentacles with violet tips rising out of the floor and curling over.
Parts.Name: Shadow Tentacles

Parts.Description: Three black obelisks with cyan tips, a purple rune ring floating around each.
Parts.Name: Rune Obelisks

Parts.Description: A tall black throne on a stepped dais, a crown of purple spikes and a cyan ring floating above it.
Parts.Name: Void Throne

Parts.Description: A black tower with glowing cyan windows and a purple flame burning on top.
Parts.Name: Dark Watchtower

Parts.Description: Nine big crystal shards drift in a ring high above the glowing rift.
Parts.Name: Floating Shards

Parts.Description: A purple sun held by a stone stand, with glowing rings and little planets turning around it.
Parts.Name: Void Orrery

Parts.Description: A colossal guardian of black stone with a purple gem in its chest and a floating cyan sword.
Parts.Name: Void Sentinel

Parts.Description: A huge ring of black and grey stone arcs on a plinth, a violet keystone on top.
Parts.Name: Portal Frame

Parts.Description: The ring fills with a swirling gate of violet, purple, magenta and cyan.
Parts.Name: Portal Swirl

Parts.Description: A black fortress with four round towers, a glowing great hall and a purple spire.
Parts.Name: Void Citadel

Parts.Description: Five comets in purple, cyan and magenta streak across the sky over the entrance.
Parts.Name: Comet Swarm

Parts.Description: A rock island floats above the plot with a ruined temple, a crystal and a purple waterfall.
Parts.Name: Flying Island

Parts.Description: Black tiers twist on top of each other up to a violet crown, a cyan ring floating high above.
Parts.Name: Twisted Spire

Parts.Description: A pitch black core hangs over the floor inside a glowing disc, jets of cyan light shoot up and down.
Parts.Name: Black Hole Core

Parts.Description: A giant eye with a purple and cyan iris stares down from a black spire over the exit.
Parts.Name: Void Eye
